description: All hand-in assignments with their window, status (AANKOMEND, IN_TE_LEVEREN, IN_AFWACHTING, AKKOORD), teLaat (always a boolean: true only for an open hand-in past its deadline), description, attachments and links. status=open keeps upcoming and to-do ones, and by default hides past-due items where no digital hand-in is expected (inleveringenVerwacht 0, e.g. on paper; count in verborgenZonderInlevering); includeNoHandIn=true keeps them. Near-duplicates (same subject, topic, window and status, e.g. published to two groups) are merged by default, with the other ids in duplicaatToekenningIds; dedupe=false lists them separately. Use toekenningId with assignment_detail. Every item lists bijlagen (fileUrl, readable with download_attachment) and externeMaterialen; empty means the teacher attached nothing (lesmateriaal=true is only a flag, there is no separate material call).

dedupe.description: Merge near-duplicate assignments (same subject, topic, window, status). Default true.

includeNoHandIn.description: With status=open: also show past-due items without a digital hand-in (inleveringenVerwacht 0). Default false.

leerlingId.description: Numeric leerling id. Required when more than one child is linked.

name: assignments
title: Assignments (hand-ins)
